title: Case: Recipient holding two boxes of items he did not order in place of a sideboard
context: A customer who ordered a sideboard from Thistlecombe Goods received two boxes of unrelated items. He has been calling the merchant about returning them.
initial_request: Nine days. Still got two boxes of somebody's parasol bases in my front room. Four calls and every one ends with resolution team, three to five days. No label. No collection. No sideboard. I gave up waiting and opened a dispute with my card company yesterday for the full amount, their ref is CB-5466. Come and get the boxes or don't. I'm past caring which.

events.body: Ordered an oak sideboard, order TG-5560. What turned up is two boxes of patio parasol bases. Not mine, never ordered them. I want them collected and my money back.

Wrong items delivered under DL-3495 / order TG-5560: the customer ordered an oak sideboard and received two boxes of parasol bases. Please issue a return label or arrange a collection and confirm to the customer, Nerys Normanton.
I have asked Thistlecombe's Return label team to issue a label or arrange a collection for the two boxes and to confirm to you. Refunds are decided by Thistlecombe and not by me.

Refunds: A refund can't start until the return has been authorised and the goods are back with us or collected. I'll pass it to the resolution team and they'll reply within three to five working days. Normanton: That is what the last person said on Monday. Refunds: I do understand. Three to five working days.
Third call this morning. Same sentence. Three to five working days.

Ticket WQ-7536 closed. We cannot issue a label or book a collection without a returns authorisation number. No RA exists for TG-5560. RAs are issued by Returns authorisations, requests by Email only. Any refund already made or payment dispute open on the order must be stated on the request.

Nine days. Still got two boxes of somebody's parasol bases in my front room. Four calls and every one ends with resolution team, three to five days. No label. No collection. No sideboard. I gave up waiting and opened a dispute with my card company yesterday for the full amount, their ref is CB-5466. Come and get the boxes or don't. I'm past caring which.

acceptable_actions.summary: Request a returns authorisation for the wrong items under TG-5560, stating that the earlier label request was closed with nothing arranged and that a card dispute for the full amount was opened on 13 June.

must: Requests a returns authorisation for the wrong items from Returns authorisations by Email, with order TG-5560 and shipment DL-3495.
States on the request that the customer opened a card dispute for the full amount on 13 June (CB-5466), so the return and any refund are handled with it in view.
Says the 5 June label request (WQ-7536) was closed with no label or collection, so nothing has been arranged, and does not present it as in progress.
Tells Returns authorisations he has held the wrong goods for nine days and made four calls that each ended with the same three-to-five-day promise, so they prioritise it and contact him directly.
must_not: Asks for a collection, label or refund without mentioning the open card dispute.
Tells Emberlee a collection or label has been arranged, or that a refund is on its way.
Advises him to withdraw, keep or pursue the card dispute, or says how it will be decided.
Sends the request to the Return label team or the Warehouse work queue again.
Tells Emberlee that a resolution team will be in touch, or gives him another number of days to wait.
expected.reference_message: Please issue a returns authorisation for order TG-5560 / shipment DL-3495. The customer, Nerys Normanton, ordered an oak sideboard and on 5 June received two boxes of patio parasol bases that he did not order. He wants them collected. I sent a label and collection request to the Return label team the same day. That ticket (WQ-7536) was closed on 13 June because no RA exists, so no label or collection has been arranged at any point. As your process requires, please note that he opened a dispute with his card issuer on 13 June for the full order amount, their reference CB-5466. I have not advised him on it. Please take it into account when you decide the return and refund, so the goods and the money are dealt with together. He has had the wrong goods in his home for nine days and has called four times, each call ending with a promise of a reply in three to five working days. Please contact him directly with the RA and the collection arrangement, and copy me.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2111: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
